deposits.notes: The paper identifies this as the S1 preregistration (pp. 12-13), not explicitly as a data deposit. The printed URL returned HTTP 200 but only the JavaScript OSF application shell. https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/dt5up/ returned HTTP 404; https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/dt5up/files/osfstorage/ returned HTTP 401 with 'Authentication credentials were not provided.'; https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/dt5up/children/ returned HTTP 404. Because the paper calls this a preregistration, the registration-specific endpoint https://api.osf.io/v2/registrations/dt5up/ was also checked and returned HTTP 401 with the same authentication message. No login or access request was attempted. File count, license, and data contents are unconfirmed. account_required records the unauthenticated API response, not a claim that any account will obtain access. studies_covered is the paper's identification of the linked study; it is not confirmation of data coverage.

Appendix A (p. 13) directs readers to this article DOI for supplementary data. The DOI returned HTTP 200 at https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S2949882125000246; its redirect destination, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2949882125000246, returned HTTP 403. No supplementary file listing was accessible, so n_files and all content flags remain null. Main-text references describe SI Tables 1-6 (demographics, rating agreement, performance regressions, HAI comparisons, group-level creativity, and perception regressions), but these references do not establish a participant-level deposit. The supplement itself was not read. The article's CC BY-NC-ND license was not assumed to cover an unseen data file. The accessible ORA copy contains only the main paper.

notes: Checked 2026-10-09. Read all 656 lines of the complete markdown conversion of the published 14-page version, including the back matter, Appendix A and references; checked relevant passages and link annotations with PyMuPDF. Quotes preserve the paper's wording, with PDF line wrapping, discretionary hyphenation, and wrapped URLs normalized. The paper contains no standalone data/code availability statement, no data-on-request promise, and no named data repository other than the preregistration link. The form's data_url and code_url are empty. No public participant-level or output-level dataset for S1 was found or read. The restricted status reflects authentication required at the cited OSF preregistration API; it does not establish that participant data exist there. Publisher HTTP 403 independently prevented examination of the referenced supplement. The two deposits are the paper's linked locations, not two confirmed datasets. Unrelated search hits and the public article PDF are not counted as data deposits. Consequently no public columns, participant identifiers, assigned arms, outcome scores, texts, row counts, or dataset license could be confirmed. None of the missing arm counts, per-person means/SDs/SEs, pooled coefficients/SEs, sample-count reconciliation, or text-based diversity statistics can presently be computed from verified public data. SI Table 3 may supply printed regression results, but this was not checked. All network requests used Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1, without credentials or personal contact identifiers. No login, access request, or bypass of access controls was attempted. No downloaded data were saved.
